# Should you surcharge cards, discount cash, or eat the fee?

> Free credit card surcharge vs cash discount calculator for small merchants: see monthly processing cost, the surcharge that recovers it, and how many customers you can lose before each option stops paying off. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
